# Selling Items That Don't Need Production

# Point of Sale: Selling Items That Don't Need Production

Some items, like pens, frames and rolls of film, are handed straight over the counter. When your store has marked them as needing no production, the till knows, and the sale finishes itself: once it's paid, the order is completed and marked picked up. There's nothing left for anyone to tidy up afterwards.

This article covers what you'll see at the till. To choose which products work this way, see **Products That Don't Need Production**.

---

## Spotting them

### On the product tile

Items that need no production show a **lightning bolt** in the top-right corner of their tile, and no "Ready in" time.

![A product tile with the lightning bolt next to a normal tile](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/d15f98b1-f8bd-4b0d-bfb5-1acd56a31952.png)

### On the product page

Instead of the Production, Turnaround and Ready boxes, the page shows **No production — handed over at the till**.

![A product page showing No production — handed over at the till](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/483c1823-7a38-49d9-9762-7032cb7e8eef.png)

### In the cart

The line shows **No production** instead of a ready date. The **Ready after** date only counts items that need making. If nothing in the cart needs making, it doesn't appear at all.

![A cart with a shelf item and a print, showing the Ready after pill](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/a723ab77-27b4-44bf-8f5a-8f4313c18772.png)

---

## Taking payment

When nothing in the cart needs production:

1. Tap **Charge**.
2. **Pay at Pickup** and **partial payment** aren't offered, because the customer is taking everything now. Take payment in full, or charge it to their account.
3. Once payment goes through, you'll see **Handed over · nothing to produce**. The order is completed and marked picked up, and the customer isn't sent a "ready" message.

![Payment screen for non production item](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/7e9325a5-b88f-4057-98e1-87db1e1977d0.png)

You might see one of these messages instead:

| Message | What it means |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Order complete · in Pickup queue** | Your store has turned off automatic pick-up. Mark it picked up from **Pickup** when the customer takes it. |
| **Couldn't hand over automatically — use Mark complete in Orders** | Something stopped the automatic step. Open the order in **Orders** and use **Mark complete**. |

---

## Mixed sales

If the cart has shelf items and things that need making, like prints, it works exactly as before. The shelf items are completed straight away, the rest goes into production, and the order arrives in the **Pickup** queue when it's ready.

---

## Custom sales

The **Custom sale** screen has a **Needs production** switch under **Taxable**. Untick it for items handed over now, e.g. shelf stock, and they're treated just like the items above.

![Custom Sale needs production](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/3df50bbc-9532-4529-9871-b32c91b4d590.png)

* Note: Whether the switch starts on or off is set by your store in OrderHub.

---

## Out of stock

Products that track stock show an **Out of stock** label on their tile when none are left at your store, and the image is dimmed. Tapping **+** shows "Out of stock" and doesn't add anything. You can still open the product to check it.

![Out of Stock](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/f5bace74-5eb7-45d0-929f-d91a62071b8a.png)

---

## Good to know

* **Add everything before you tap Charge.** Tapping Charge creates the order. If you close the payment window to add another item and charge again, the first order is left behind as **Pending**, showing **Payment not completed**, with its stock still held. Cancel it from **Orders** — see **Pending Orders from the Till**.
* **The bolt is a guide.** OrderHub makes the final decision when the order is created, so if a setting has just changed, the order still comes out right.
